description: Tron transaction inspection on UNSIGNED raw_data hex (tronweb raw_data_hex): op=decode (contracts, owner/to, amount_sun, TRC-20 call, ref block, expiry, fee limit, txid), txid (sha256 of raw_data). A tx that carries signatures is refused (signed_tx_refused); signed bytes stay in the wallet. Pure, offline computation (blocktools); nothing is fetched or stored. How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).
name: tron_tx
title: Decode Tron raw_data / compute txid (dev tool)
